subject: Re: ENAS-LM kickoff: architecture search for small on-device LMs
body:
Anders,

Resourcing rundown.

People: Ondrej 70% on the search/controller side, Wanjiru 80% on the fixed-arc evaluation paths (TPU and GPU), Paloma 50% on the service API and data plumbing.

Compute: I've asked for a 1x1 slice from our Cirrus quarterly allocation for the TPU eval runs in May; GPU-side comparisons ride Titan best-effort. The TPU path is the one that reproduces 56.1 perplexity, so it's the one that matters for the writeup.

Data: PTB preprocessing (the process step into the pkl bundle) is trivial, but the larger search-space experiments pull corpora through the Corpus platform. Good news on timing - Corpus v2 migration freeze is 2026-08-07, so our corpus ingestion for the search-space experiments can keep running on the v1 path through all of July - no migration work needed inside our window.

Risk: Cirrus quarterly allocation is contended; if we lose the May slice, the TPU numbers slip to June.

Daniela
